meta.name: The Tavern
meta.blurb: Panic, rumour, and deserters who can still hold a blade.

activities.name: Drink and listen
activities.blurb: Nurse a cup where every fear in the parish is said aloud, and twice over.

activities.name: Gamble
activities.blurb: Dice and cards with deserters and dockhands, at a table where coin buys less every week and the pots grow reckless.

activities.name: Work behind the bar
activities.blurb: Pour, mop, and hear every traveller's news before the lord on his hill ever does.
